authority_boundary: This map records where real capability and skill artifacts live in the repository and relates them to the Capability Ledger. It does not modify runtime. Ledger status authority remains docs/p2p-development/capability-ledger/capability-index.json; goal authority remains governance/development-control.json.

codex_skills.description: Codex Edition skills under .agents/skills/. 63 top-level skill directories; 89 SKILL.md files in total (some skills nest child skills). These are the on-demand skill units the Codex Edition agent loads.
codex_skills.maturity: Production-loaded in the Codex Edition. Per-skills status lives in the Capability Ledger; see ledger families TRUTH_AND_GOVERNANCE, EXECUTION_AND_ORCHESTRATION, CONTEXT_AND_KNOWLEDGE, SKILL_AND_LEARNING, MULTI_AI_INTEROPERABILITY, ROUTING_AND_COGNITIVE_ECONOMY, VERIFICATION_AND_EVALUATION, RECOVERY_AND_CONTINUATION, BEGINNER_LIFECYCLE, OUTCOME_LEARNING, DESIGN_AND_PRODUCT_INTELLIGENCE, DURABLE_PROJECT_INTELLIGENCE.
